abstract: Patients with advanced germ cell tumors can be cured with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, but the outcome remains unsatisfactory for patients with relapsed disease, including those patients with refractory disease after bone marrow transplantation. Targeted therapies have changed the standard of care for many advanced solid tumors. We have identified, in the literature, potential targets for the treatment of refractory germ cell tumors, and applied to a patient with a refractory disease. We chose sunitinib for this purpose. To our knowledge, this is the first case to be treated with sunitinib, and we have found a promising activity.
abstract_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍はシスプラチン併用化学療法により治癒しうるが、再発例や骨髄移植後の難治例を含め、治療成績は不良である。分子標的療法は、進行固形癌の標準治療を変えてきた。我々は文献から難治性胚細胞腫瘍の治療標的を同定し、難治例の1症例に適用した。スニチニブを選択した。我々の知る限り、これは胚細胞腫瘍に対してスニチニブで治療された初の症例であり、有望な活性が認められた。
